## POST /v1/verify

Perform a comprehensive identity verification check using biometric and document data.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| firstName | string | true | User's first name |
| lastName | string | true | User's last name |
| email | string | true | User's email address |
| phone | string | true | User's phone number |
| dateOfBirth | date | true | User's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| idType | string | true | Type of government-issued ID (e.g. "passport", "driver's license") |
| idNumber | string | true | ID document number |
| idCountry | string | true | Country that issued the ID document |
| idExpiry | date | true | Expiration date of the ID document (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| selfieImage | binary | true | Base64-encoded image of user's face |
| idImage | binary | true | Base64-encoded image of ID document |

### Request Body

```json

  "lastName": "Doe",
